wholePhysicalScope: The native map fixes the 710 Nguyễn Trãi compound, two lateral wings, rear building and three street gates. The historic timber temple is about 65 m long by 27 m wide. Its open forecourt is within the longer mapped site.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the axial halls, long side ranges and open courts. Closer levels add the ceramic ridge figures, individual eave tiles, timber and stone columns and green entrance grille.
limitations: The model represents the exterior, axial halls and visible courtyards in September 2019. Individual ceramic figures are simplified and the shrine furnishings are outside the model scope.
The mapped compound and annexes anchor the footprint. Heights and unmeasured roof sections are estimated from the exterior and courtyard views.
The urban source elevation field is kept intact. Contact and interior paving levels use approximate vertical registration.
